description_en: A deep rectangular woven carry bag with tall canvas roll-top neck, leather base corners and removable shoulder strap. Canonical front: the front woven wall beneath the folded canvas closure. Side view: a deep rectangular gusset with strap ring. Rear view: two vertical leather reinforcement strips and woven back wall. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A deep rectangular woven carry bag with tall canvas roll-top neck, leather base corners and removable shoulder strap. Canonical front: the front woven wall beneath the folded canvas closure. Side view: a deep rectangular gusset with strap ring. Rear view: two vertical leather reinforcement strips and woven back wall. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings and continuous strips; solid wood/bamboo supports and secondary materials only where specified. Keep natural product resting/display orientation. Flexible mats/runners remain thin and flat, without unrequested feet, stands or rigid frames. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, matching appropriate elevation for its natural resting pose. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
